runner_pressure.command:
ruby -I scripts -r ./scripts/check_recursive_json_array_tuple_parts_w187.rb -e '
p = CheckRecursiveJSONArrayTuplePartsW187::Probe.allocate
header = [0x82, 9, 8].pack("CVV")
frames = ("\0" * 16 + header) * 2
walk = p.send(:compressed_frame_spans!, frames, "w188")
bytes = [1].pack("Q<") + [1,1,0,3,0,0,255,2].pack("C*")
groups = p.send(:parse_compact_groups!, bytes, [0,1,3,0], "w188")
inventory = {mark_triples: {"w188" => [[0,8,2],[25,0,2],[25,3,2],[50,0,2],[50,0,0]]}}
result = p.send(:bind_compact_mark_groups!, inventory, "w188", groups, walk.fetch(:spans), 50, 16)
raise "positive normalized offsets" unless result.fetch(:normalized_decoded_offsets) == [8,8,11,16,16]
checks = 0
[
  -> { p.send(:bind_compact_mark_groups!, {mark_triples: {"w188" => [[1,8,2],[25,0,2],[25,3,2],[50,0,2],[50,0,0]]}}, "w188", groups, walk.fetch(:spans), 50, 16) },
  -> { p.send(:parse_compact_groups!, bytes + "\0", [0,1,3,0], "w188") },
  -> { altered = bytes.dup; altered.setbyte(8,2); p.send(:parse_compact_groups!, altered, [0,1,3,0], "w188") },
  -> { p.send(:compressed_frame_spans!, "\0"*16 + [0x82,9,1048577].pack("CVV"), "w188") }
].each do |candidate|
  begin
    candidate.call
  rescue RuntimeError => e
    raise unless e.message.start_with?("W187 recursive Array/Tuple JSON probe:")
    checks += 1
  end
end
raise "negative accepted" unless checks == 4
mod = CheckRecursiveJSONArrayTuplePartsW187
raise "NULL input lost" unless mod::CompactElements[3]["l"].key?("a_left") && mod::CompactElements[3]["l"]["a_left"].nil?
raise "canonical NULL wrongly retained" if mod::CompactReadElements[3]["l"].key?("a_left")
puts "two-frame-coordinate positive; 4 adversarial rejections; NULL input/read separation: PASS"
'
